description: Wave-11 Tier-1 cell manifest: 3 models x 5 policies x (8 WikiText-2 PPL chunks + 8 representative NIAH stimuli) = 240 cells. Each cell is a single eviction_bench invocation; the runner is responsible for cool-down, sensor sampling, memory gating, and per-cell output dir. Policy v1_fa2_stack bundles --policy v1_fa2 with the Wave-9 thermal stack (Q8 K-cache + anchor-top-k=32 + recent-budget=476 + n-sink=4).
ppl_corpus: WikiText-2 test (wiki.test.raw), split into 8 sequential ~512-token chunks; PPL via eviction_bench --ppl-mode --ppl-stride 512.
